rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (now FIXED): _canonicalize_lock_score is applied to every picks endpoint's return path, promoting v2 → canonical lock_score at READ time (the DB promotion runs are now belt-and-suspenders, not load-bearing). Combined with frontend getDisplayLockRounded() helper used on every surface (LockPickCard, pick/[id].tsx, parlay, under, rollover, soccer-lab, slip), there are now TWO independent guarantees: backend serialises max(v1,v2) and frontend re-derives max(v1,v2). Either one alone would fix the bug; together they're robust to future drift.
